newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK EASIER ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK EASIER ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted marginally easier on hard units on Monday but dealers predicted it would hold steady the rest of the day in quiet trade.
"Most people seem quite happy with where the (exchange) rates are at the moment. I don't see them moving that much today," one commented.
At around 0730 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading softer on the U.S. dollar at 10.3300/3500 compared to Friday's 10.3250/3450 while against sterling it slipped to 16.1300/1680 from 16.1250/1660.
It was at 2.2820/2890 from 2.2770/2830 versus the rand but edged up on the mark to 6.7650/7800 from 6.7830/7960.
